description: This Java source file defines the BinaryDataHandler class, which implements handling of complex obs data (such as files) for the OpenMRS medical record system. It supports retrieving and saving binary data, especially files, associated with observations, and interacts with storage services to read/write data. The class supports the 'RAW_VIEW' for raw file handling and is annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: BinaryDataHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that handles storing and retrieving complex observation data (like files) for the OpenMRS system, implementing the ComplexObsHandler interface.

methods.name: BinaryDataHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves the complex data observation for a specified view, supports 'RAW_VIEW' for raw files.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported views, currently only 'RAW_VIEW'.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the complex data from an observation into storage and updates the valueComplex property.
